images.screen: A · 편성 — 칸 순서가 곧 뽑는 순서다
images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a 2D side-view deckbuilding strategy game, 16:9 landscape, full-bleed, no device frame, no poster framing, no logo. Upper half: a stylized flat-shaded side view of a long freight train crossing a red desert canyon at golden-hour dusk, layered parallax mesas in maroon and rust, a big pale sun low on the horizon, dust in the air. The train, left to right: a dark red steam locomotive, then eight distinct cars, each a different card: a black coal hopper, a flatcar with a steel-blue gun turret, a brown wooden boxcar with an X-braced door, a green dining car with warm yellow windows, a riveted grey armored car, another brown boxcar, a short flatcar carrying huge golden chain links, and a second turret car. One car (the green dining car) is lifted slightly above the track with a drop shadow as if being dragged by the mouse to a new position, the other cars sliding apart to make room. Small rounded label pills under the cars connect neighbors with thin colored brackets, Korean text exactly: "사기 +2" (mint green), "앞뒤 함께 발동" (gold), "기관차 옆 · 에너지 +2" (grey). Above, three dark silhouette raiders ride on the far side of the canyon (a horseman, an armored truck, a rifleman), each with a small salmon health bar and a red intent badge: "1턴 공격 4", "1턴 쉰다", "1턴 공격 3". Top-left title in bold Korean: "섞지 않는 덱". Lower half: a dark brown translucent panel with a turn timeline table, columns "1턴" to "6턴", rows of attack numbers per raider, and a bottom row "들어오는 칸" showing two small colored car chips per turn. Bottom right a large orange button: "출발 — 협곡으로". Clean modern indie UI, warm palette, crisp vector-like art, readable Korean typography.

images.screen: B · 습격 — 다음 역의 두 칸이 손에 든다
images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a 2D side-view train deckbuilder mid-combat, 16:9 landscape, full-bleed, no device frame, no poster framing. Upper half: the same flat-shaded freight train racing along rails through a red canyon at dusk, motion dust clouds swirling, the canyon background streaked with speed. A glowing pale-gold bracket hovers above two adjacent cars of the train (a coal hopper and a turret flatcar) with a small Korean caption exactly "2번째 역 — 이 칸들이 손에 든다". The turret car is firing: a bright muzzle flash and a tracer line toward a dark silhouette horseman raider riding beside the train, a yellow floating damage number "-5" above him; the golden chain coupler car next to it pulses with light, linking its two neighbors. An armored truck raider shows a red badge "이번 턴 공격 7". Lower half: dark translucent UI. Center: two large playing cards rising from the bottom, each card showing the side-view art of a train car, a round yellow energy cost in the corner, and Korean text, left card "포탑칸 · 맨 앞 습격대에 5 피해 (+2 사기)", right card "연결칸 · 앞뒤 칸을 한 번 더 발동". Left panel: train health bar "체력 14 / 22", block "막기 4", three round energy pips with two lit. Right panel: a short combat log in Korean and an orange button "턴 끝 — 습격을 받는다". Warm rust and teal palette, clean indie strategy game UI, crisp readable Korean typography.
